The scoring was rounded off deep into stoppage time when Rayan , who had come on as a substitute, clinicaly converted a fast break following an assist from Daniel Jebbison . The 4-0 victory was a testament to Bournemouth 's clinical finishing and tactical discipline, ensuring their safe passage to the next round of the Carabao Cup .
